discriminating_terms: constitute a breach of the agreement
attributions.rationale: In "constitute a breach of the agreement," the act is evaluated as satisfying the classification 'breach,' selecting sense:002. Sense:001 would require the subject to form a whole or occupy a stated share, but this use of constitute expresses neither a component-whole relation nor a proportion.

discriminating_terms: legally constituted officer of the association
attributions.rationale: The phrase "legally constituted officer of the association" describes a person in the result state of having been formally appointed or authorized as an officer, selecting sense:004. Sense:003 establishes an organization such as a board or commission, whereas the constituted entity here is an individual officeholder, not an organization.

In "constitutes a significant change," the revised policy is classified and evaluated as a change, selecting sense:002. Sense:001 would construe the policy as a component or quantitative share of a whole, but no whole, part relation, or proportion is expressed by this use of constitute.

discriminating_terms: The commission was constituted under the new environmental law
attributions.rationale: "The commission was constituted under the new environmental law" presents a commission as the organization brought formally into existence, selecting sense:003. Sense:004 concerns appointing a person to a named role, but the passive subject is an organization and there is no person-plus-role complement.

discriminating_terms: does not constitute proof of fraud
attributions.rationale: In "does not constitute proof of fraud," the message is judged not to meet the standard for the classification 'proof,' selecting sense:002. Sense:001 would require a component-whole or proportion relation, which this negative evidentiary evaluation does not encode.

"May constitute a criminal offence" evaluates an act against the conditions for the classification 'criminal offence,' selecting sense:002. Sense:003 would describe formally forming an organization, but here constitute links conduct to a legal classification and has no organizational result object.

discriminating_terms: constitute 35 percent of the company's revenue
attributions.rationale: The exact frame "constitute 35 percent of the company's revenue" states a quantified share and names the whole in an of-phrase, uniquely selecting the proportion use in sense:001. Sense:002 classifies or evaluates something as a state or category; it does not supply this percentage-of-a-whole relation.

In "is constituted of experts," the of-phrase identifies the experts as the components making up the panel, selecting the composition relation in sense:001. Sense:003 would report the formal establishment of the panel, but this use of constitute specifies its constituent members rather than an establishment event.

discriminating_terms: constitute a significant part of the annual budget
attributions.rationale: "Constitute a significant part of the annual budget" explicitly relates maintenance costs as a part to the annual budget as its whole, selecting sense:001. Sense:002 would make the object an evaluative category or state, whereas "part of" directly encodes the part-whole relation.

In "The ministry constituted an independent panel," the ministry acts as the institutional agent that formally creates the panel, selecting sense:003. Sense:001 would require the subject to be a component that makes up the object, but the ministry is the creator and is not presented as one of the panel's constituent parts.

discriminating_terms: constitutes a serious risk to public safety
attributions.rationale: "Constitutes a serious risk to public safety" evaluates the damaged bridge as amounting to the state or classification 'serious risk,' selecting sense:002. Sense:001 would express that the bridge forms a whole or a share of one, but no component-whole or proportional relation appears in this use.

discriminating_terms: constituted him treasurer of the association
attributions.rationale: The object-complement frame "constituted him treasurer of the association" assigns a person ('him') the formal role 'treasurer,' uniquely selecting sense:004. Sense:003 takes an organization as the result object of establishment and cannot account for this person-plus-office complement structure.

In "a tribunal to be constituted," the passive infinitive describes bringing a tribunal, an institutional body, into formal existence, selecting sense:003. Sense:004 appoints a person to a role, but the constituted entity here is the tribunal itself and no personal role complement occurs.

discriminating_terms: Twelve jurors constitute the full jury
attributions.rationale: "Twelve jurors constitute the full jury" places the constituent persons as subject and the whole they make up as object, exactly selecting sense:001. Sense:003 would require an agent intentionally establishing an organization, but here the jurors are components in a static part-whole relation rather than an establishing agent.

discriminating_terms: what constitutes acceptable use of the system
attributions.rationale: The embedded question "what constitutes acceptable use of the system" asks which conduct satisfies the definition or conditions of 'acceptable use,' selecting sense:002. Sense:001 would ask which components make up a whole, but 'acceptable use' is an evaluative classification here, not a compositional whole or stated share.

discriminating_terms: agreed to constitute a transitional government
attributions.rationale: In "agreed to constitute a transitional government," intentional agents undertake to bring a government into existence, selecting sense:003. Sense:001 could describe parties as components forming a whole in a stative frame, but the purposive infinitive after "agreed to" presents deliberate establishment, not a component-whole relation.

discriminating_terms: constitute the majority of the evening staff
attributions.rationale: "Constitute the majority of the evening staff" states that part-time employees occupy a majority share of the named whole, selecting sense:001. Sense:002 would classify the employees as a category or state, but the majority-of frame instead directly encodes a proportional part-whole relation.

The passive person-plus-role frame "She was constituted guardian" describes her formal appointment to the role of guardian, selecting sense:004. Sense:003 concerns establishing an organization, whereas the constituted participant here is a person and 'guardian' is her appointed office.

"A duly constituted board" describes a board in the result state of having been formally and properly established, selecting sense:003. Sense:001 can express composition when constituent parts are related to a whole, but this phrase names no components or of-phrase; "duly" instead modifies the formal establishment status of the organization.
